about: Analyses written by the full price check for cards that stand out (scripts/outliers.py). Shown on the card page above the automatic findings. Edit with scripts/set_insight.py.

https://snkrdunk.com/apparels/138599.headline: Ask up 12% in a week, now 11% above where sales are clearing
https://snkrdunk.com/apparels/138599.text:
What's happening: The lowest PSA10 ask rose from ¥29,400 to ¥33,000 in a week while my tier index slipped about 2%. The last 17 sales cleared at a median of ¥29,800, about 11% under the ask, and only 6 of 20 listings sit within 15% of it.

Why: Likely sellers relisting higher after the cheapest copies sold, not new demand; that is a reading of the data, not a confirmed cause. A search for a 2026 reprint of the VMAX Climax set found nothing relevant, so I found no supply or news reason.

For you: The ask is above the Buy line (¥29,500) and well above your ¥26,000 limit. With the correction rule on, this stays a Watch. The slab premium is also low against its usual level, so a chase at this ask has little support.

Watch: Whether sales keep clearing near ¥29,800 or move up to the new ask, and whether the thin book fills back in under ¥30,000.

The ask sits above the Buy line (¥38,000) and your limit (¥35,000), so there is nothing to do; watch whether sales pick back up before treating this as a new floor.

https://snkrdunk.com/apparels/585221.headline: Lowest ask 11% under recent sales, but price is still sliding

What's happening: The lowest PSA10 ask is ¥100,000, about 11% under the ¥112,000 median of recent sales. The sales print sequence has stepped down from ¥120,000–125,000 on 09-25 to ¥97,900–105,000 over the last few days, and trading is about 2.9 sales a day.

Why: Likely the same market-wide correction seen in the tier index, and sellers marking down to keep selling. That is a reading of the data, not a confirmed cause; I found no reprint or supply news for this set.

https://snkrdunk.com/apparels/224087.headline: Cheap listings bought out; ask jumped 10% to ¥48,000 while sales sit near ¥42,650
https://snkrdunk.com/apparels/224087.text:
What's happening: The lowest PSA10 ask went from ¥43,800 to ¥48,000 since the last check, 13% above the recent sales median of ¥42,650. Two sales at ¥50,000 and ¥52,999 printed yesterday, and 20 sales cleared in the last 7 days (about 2.9 a day).

Why: Likely the cheapest listings were bought and the next ones are priced higher; the ¥50,000+ prints may be a few buyers paying up. This is a reading of the data. A search found no announced reprint of this card; it did show an altema page for a separate 30周年 ゲッコウガex SAR, which I did not open, so I can't say what it means for this card.

For you: The ask is just under the Ceiling (¥49,000) and above your ¥37,000 limit and the Buy line (¥43,000). Stay on Watch; the slab premium (1.25x vs a norm of about 1.73x, as of 09-16) is low, which argues against paying the higher ask.

Watch: Whether asks drift back toward ¥43,000, and how the 30周年 Greninja trades once it has a PSA10 market.

https://snkrdunk.com/apparels/100567.headline: Slab premium at 1.07x vs a usual 1.76x, ask 8% above sales
https://snkrdunk.com/apparels/100567.text:
What's happening: The lowest PSA10 ask is ¥143,000, about 8% above the ¥132,000 median of recent sales, and 12 of 20 listings sit within 15% of it. Sales are running at about 3.9 a day, with prints between ¥126,800 and ¥142,000 over the past week.

Why: The slab sells at only 1.07x the raw price against a six-month norm of about 1.76x (pokeca-chart, 2026-09-28), so raw is priced high relative to the slab, or the slab is cheap. This is a reading of the data; I found no reprint or supply news for this set.

For you: The ask is just under the Ceiling (¥145,000), well above the Buy line (¥128,000) and your ¥90,000 limit. The correction rule keeps this at Watch.

Watch: Whether sales keep clearing near ¥130,000, and whether the raw price falls toward the slab (which would lift the premium back).
